safe_activation_protocol.join_order: ascending register_ns with flow_id as the tie breaker
safe_activation_protocol.fast_join_rule: for each admitted small-set join, fully ACK every required incumbent prepare grant before sending the required newcomer activation grant
safe_activation_protocol.high_transition_rule: the fifth registration irreversibly enters high-fan-in collection; transition prepare begins only after both collection flush and serialized small-set closure, then activation waits for the exact receiver-observed prefix of every frozen waiter
safe_activation_protocol.transition_union_rule: transition prepare incumbent flow IDs and transition activation waiter flow IDs are disjoint and their union is every registered lifecycle flow
safe_activation_protocol.release_rule: after safe activation closure, every admitted release generation is ACK-optional, contains no join, and never decreases a continuing target; low-mode release is optional and immediate, while post-transition high-mode release obeys the geometric active-count rule
safe_activation_protocol.retry_semantics: wire frame accounting includes every retry and duplicate ACK; the frozen normal path admits neither
safe_activation_protocol.terminal_condition: phase, pending ACKs, pending membership, waiter snapshots, collection state, revision delta, prefix timer, activation cohort, batch cursor, target map, and held references are all zero

transition_prefix_protocol.scope: the single N>4 high-fan-in transition activation
transition_prefix_protocol.cohort_provenance: every incumbent and waiter belongs to the same receiver NIC, receiver capacity, and priority group; the frozen workload uses receiver 15 and priority group 4
transition_prefix_protocol.ready_rule: every frozen live waiter has receiver_next_expected_seq greater than or equal to target_bytes
transition_prefix_protocol.normal_activation_rule: after exact-prefix readiness, send one required transition_activate generation to the complete live waiter cohort in ascending register_ns and flow_id order
transition_prefix_protocol.normal_activation_evidence: each receiver-authoritative transition_activate sent row has prefix_observed_bytes>=prefix_target_bytes, drain_outcome=ready, activation_batch_index=1, activation_batch_size equal to the actual waiter cohort, and the same nonzero generation and transaction target
transition_prefix_protocol.fallback_policy: a nominal liveness timeout may use ordered ACK-clocked microbatches of at most four, but any timeout, degraded transition, fallback batch, fallback closure, order violation, or barrier violation rejects the campaign
transition_prefix_protocol.low_n_rule: N in {2,4} must not start, resolve, timeout, or retain any prefix-barrier state

initial_collection_protocol.scope: the first high-fan-in waiter snapshot after the fifth registration
initial_collection_protocol.timer_rule: schedule at min(last_waiter_registration_ns + quiet_ns, transition_registration_ns + derived_hard_ns)
initial_collection_protocol.barrier_rule: transition_prepare_start_ns is not earlier than collection_flush_ns or prefix_close_ns
initial_collection_protocol.hard_tie_rule: a quiet target equal to the hard deadline is classified as a hard flush
initial_collection_protocol.post_initial_rule: retain the 12480-ns post-initial window and geometric completion-release behavior

selection_policy: K=4, V11 safe phases, the V12 exact-prefix barrier, V11 seed-126 formal replay inputs, fresh pilot and formal identities, frame ceilings, unchanged 60-byte low-queue correction, aggregate N=15 gates, and per-seed N=15 stability gates are frozen before replay. Replay and pilot are mechanism-only. Formal performance remains sealed until all 40 mechanism cells pass. A failure rejects V12 and cannot select another parameter, prefix rule, seed, N, arm, queue gate, or subset.

candidate_admission.low_n_frame_bound_derivation: serialized safe admission is at most N(N+1) frames and immediate per-completion optional release is at most N(N-1)/2 grant frames, for total F <= (3N^2+N)/2

scalability_holdout.required_control_frame_envelope: F<=7,26,43,64 at N=2,4,8,15 respectively; the low-N values safely include immediate per-completion optional release, and the high-N values are frozen event-pattern ceilings rather than a universal asymptotic claim

scope_limits: V12 is a preregistered test of exact-prefix transition activation layered on V11 safety, not an admitted default algorithm.
The 60-byte small-queue absolute CI gate is retained unchanged from V11.
The fifth registration selects high-fan-in mode irreversibly within the epoch; no parameter or performance-based threshold selection is allowed.
The frame ceilings include retries and are only for the frozen one-epoch completion-only identities through N=15; V12 makes no universal sub-3N claim.
Remaining-aware refresh, proactive release, receiver concurrency, size priority, and tail bypass remain outside this isolation experiment.
Performance metrics remain sealed until replay, pilot, and every formal mechanism cell pass.
